This page describes the Stata code retained after retirement of the former
tabulations and briefings workflows. Routine Stata production is now limited
to the CVD event and CVD mortality release workflows and their supporting
utilities.

Detailed run instructions belong in the Operations and Technical Manuals. The
manuals will be revised separately after the reporting redesign is complete.

## Current operational entry points

| Area | File | Responsibility |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Configuration | [`config/bnr_paths_TEMPLATE.do`](config/bnr_paths_TEMPLATE.do) | Defines and validates the public/private workstation path contract. Copy it to the untracked `bnr_paths_LOCAL.do` and enter local paths there. |
| Menu | [`menu/bnr_menu.do`](menu/bnr_menu.do) | Creates the current **User > BNR** menu for the CVD event workflow, mortality workflow and retained utilities. |
| Shared CVD configuration | [`common/bnrcvd_globals.do`](common/bnrcvd_globals.do) | Defines shared run metadata and CVD display constants. It contains no credentials or machine-specific paths. |
| Shared metric staging | [`common/bnr_step4_stage_metric.do`](common/bnr_step4_stage_metric.do) | Validates and packages unsuppressed metric outputs and QA evidence in private staging. |
| Shared disclosure control | [`common/bnr_step5_suppress.do`](common/bnr_step5_suppress.do) | Applies the established disclosure-control contract used by the CVD metric workflow. |

The machine-specific `config/bnr_paths_LOCAL.do` is required on each
workstation but must never be committed.

## CVD event release workflow

| Step | File | Responsibility |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | [`monthly/bnr_step1_cvd_redcap_extract.do`](monthly/bnr_step1_cvd_redcap_extract.do) | Extract the selected cumulative REDCap release and write the private raw dataset, manifest and log. |
| 2 | [`monthly/bnr_step2_cvd_confidential.do`](monthly/bnr_step2_cvd_confidential.do) | Harmonise the selected release with the historical CVD data and create the confidential cumulative dataset and QA outputs. |
| 3 | [`monthly/bnr_step3_metric_inputs.do`](monthly/bnr_step3_metric_inputs.do) | Create authorised deidentified analytical inputs. |
| 4 | [`monthly/bnr_step4_metrics.do`](monthly/bnr_step4_metrics.do) | Run the CVD burden, incidence and mortality-linkage calculations and stage the combined private metric package. |
| 5 | [`monthly/bnr_step5_review.do`](monthly/bnr_step5_review.do) | Prepare the disclosure-controlled candidate and record approval of the reviewed package. |
| 6 | [`monthly/bnr_step6_publish.do`](monthly/bnr_step6_publish.do) | Verify and publish the exact approved CVD metric package and refresh the website dataset mirror. |

Additional Step 5 and Step 6 controllers retained in `monthly/` support the
expanded CVD disclosure and publication contract. Analytical components,
linkage diagnostics, rate construction, suppression stages and their tests are
stored under `metrics/cvd/`.

The public CVD tables page is not a separate Stata workflow. It reads the
approved event and mortality metric CSV files through Quarto and Observable JS.

## CVD mortality release workflow

| Step | File | Responsibility |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | [`mortality/bnr_mort_s1_extract.do`](mortality/bnr_mort_s1_extract.do) | Extract and stage the authorised mortality source release. |
| 2 | [`mortality/bnr_mort_s2_classify.do`](mortality/bnr_mort_s2_classify.do) | Apply the controlled cause-of-death classification rules and create review evidence. |
| 3 | [`mortality/bnr_mort_s3_burden.do`](mortality/bnr_mort_s3_burden.do) | Build the private mortality burden package, including counts, distributions and rates. |
| 4 | [`mortality/bnr_mort_s4_review.do`](mortality/bnr_mort_s4_review.do) | Apply disclosure control and prepare the mortality release candidate for human review. |
| 5 | [`mortality/bnr_mort_s5_approve.do`](mortality/bnr_mort_s5_approve.do) | Record approval of the exact reviewed mortality package. |
| 6 | [`mortality/bnr_mort_s6_publish.do`](mortality/bnr_mort_s6_publish.do) | Verify and publish the approved mortality package and refresh the website mirror. |

Supporting mortality calculation, staging, dictionaries, classification rules
and tests are retained under `mortality/`. The workflow contract is documented
in `mortality/BNR_MORTALITY_WORKFLOW_CONTRACT.md`.

## Dialogs and Stata help

- Current menu dialogs are stored under `dialogs/`.
- Command-specific Stata help files are stored under `help/`.
- A dialog constructs the same command as direct DO-file use; it does not
  create a second analytical pathway.
- When a DO file is retired, its matching dialog and Stata help file must be
  retired with it.

## Validation and historical material

Synthetic, regression and contract tests are stored beside the workflow they
validate, principally under `metrics/cvd/tests/` and `mortality/tests/`.

The files under `refit/` are historical diagnostic evidence rather than
routine release steps. They must not be added to the Stata menu.

## Retired workflows

The following are no longer part of the live Stata tree or menu:

- the four-step CVD tabulations package workflow;
- the three-step routine and ad-hoc briefings workflow;
- the case-fatality and length-of-stay briefing analysis programs;
- briefing-specific staging, workbook and YAML utilities; and
- tests, dialogs and Stata help belonging only to those workflows.

The Git history and the September 2026 repository archive preserve the retired
implementation. Do not restore those files as dependencies of the replacement
reporting design.

## Maintenance rule

Before changing a shared helper, identify every caller. Keep analytical
decisions in the relevant workflow component, and keep approval and publication
mechanics separate from calculation.

After a workflow change:

1. search for retired filenames and commands;
2. open every current menu dialog and help link;
3. run the relevant synthetic or regression checks;
4. run an end-to-end product workflow where practical;
5. run the local-link check and a full Quarto render; and
6. inspect Git status before committing.
